[[File:Sinister Offering icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Sinister Offering''' is a spell within the [[Arceuus spellbook]] that requires level 92 [[Magic]] and the completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]] to be cast. When cast, the spell instantly offers up to three bones in the player's inventory, granting 300% the normal experience for burying them. Players must have level 70 [[Prayer]] in order to offer [[superior dragon bones]] via the spell, attempting to do so without 70 Prayer gives the message {{mes|You require a Prayer level of 70 to do that.}}. Players may only cast offering spells once every 5.4 seconds.

The spell also restores one prayer point for each set of bones converted; for [[Ourg bones|ourg]], [[Dagannoth bones|dagannoth]], [[hydra bones|hydra]], and [[superior dragon bones]], two prayer points are restored instead.

The spell can be cast without runes at the [[Fountain of Rune]].
